title: PAH-OMC-002 conditional Gibbs projected identity has an exact finite defect
question: For the exact PAH-OMC-002 conditional Gibbs kernel on one finite anchor-preserving subdivision, does E_kappa L_(rho') I_p equal L_rho on the invariant cylinder core?
decision_reason: The exact PAH-OMC-002 Gibbs fibre average is normalized and gauge-equivariant in the finite fixture, but the retained aperture rate depends on the hidden aperture through the unchanged positive kappa_s edge term. For the invariant cylinder observable f=j_v, the coarse increment is zero while the two hidden fine increments are +1/8 and -1/8. Equal fibre Gibbs weights therefore produce the strict factor (exp(-1/16)+exp(1/16))/2>1, so the projected identity fails on an exact finite witness. This retires only the named conditional-Gibbs projected route and leaves PAH-001 and the strong target unchanged.
method: Pin PAH-001, PAH-OMC-001, PAH-OMC-002 and its manifest by raw-byte SHA-256.

Instantiate the unchanged PAH aperture terms on the two-vertex coarse carrier and the three-vertex fine carrier with a fine-only vertex, fixed Q=0 and no plaquettes so the omitted matter and Wilson contributions are exactly zero.
Enumerate the 32 coarse and 256 fine integer-coordinate states, verify p_Omega fibres, finite Gibbs positivity, kernel normalization, gauge equivariance and retained-root inverse transport.
Evaluate f=j_v at the all-zero coarse state and compare the exact coarse aperture increment with both hidden fine increments.
Derive the conditional exponential factor and its strict positivity independently, run the hostile mutation firewall, and compile the exact Lean inequalities.
decision_scope: One finite PAH-OMC-002 conditional-Gibbs map: coarse vertices v,w with retained edge e and anchors C=v,O=w; fine vertices v,z,w with retained e and hidden edge d=(v,z); K=2, M_s=M_psi=1, Q=0, epsilon=1/2, R_max=1, beta=1, nu=1, lambda_s=1, kappa_s=1, positive inherited remaining couplings, counting-measure Gibbs normalization, external stochastic Markov time, no limit.
finding: Primary 26/26, non-importing independent 20/20, hostile 12/12 with 12/12 mutations rejected, integrated 17/17, and Lean R480 pass. The witness fibre has eight states and equal fine Gibbs energy 3/8 for hidden j_z=0,1. The coarse AP(v,+) increment is 0; fine increments are +1/8 and -1/8; the common mobility squared is 1/2; and the normalized projected rate defect is (exp(-1/16)+exp(1/16))/2-1>0 with observed absolute defect 0.0013815175569305126. The route-local conditional projected identity therefore fails exactly.

adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS ROUTE-LOCAL ONLY: the result retires the exact OMC-002 Gibbs average on this map; alternative owner-authorized kernels remain open.

adversarial_review.disposition: REJECTED: the contract keeps strong_mainline and conditional_projected separate, and the integrated firewall leaves Stage 2 HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
